review_candidates.title: Senior Data Systems Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Description Build the next generation of Oracle Zero Data Loss Recovery Appliance (ZDLRA) software, helping fortune 500 enterprises protect and recover their business-critical Oracle databases. Work on software where data integrity, recoverability, cyber resilience, and performance at scale directly affect customers' most important operations. Join our growing engineering team in Bengaluru and collaborate with experienced ZDLRA engineers in India and the US. You will contribute to shared product priorities, deliver new features and projects, and help evolve an enterprise data protection platform. This role offers the opportunity to help shape a new team while building deep product expertise within an established global engineering organization. The work spans Oracle database kernel development and systems programming, primarily in C and PL/SQL on Linux. You will tackle engineering problems involving buffers and caches, memory management, storage, file systems, I/O, networking, concurrency, and distributed systems. Strong algorithms, thoughtful design, and an understanding of how these components interact will be central to delivering correct, efficient, and maintainable software. You will participate throughout the development lifecycle: understanding problems, exploring the codebase, identifying root causes, designing solutions, implementing changes, writing tests, and validating results. The work combines new development and enhancements with complex defect resolution, including issues encountered in customer environments. As your product knowledge grows, you will take increasing technical ownership of assigned features and components, contributing to design decisions, code reviews, ongoing maintenance, and knowledge sharing. We value engineers who investigate problems systematically, use documentation and diagnostic tools resourcefully, communicate clearly, and help colleagues succeed. You will use modern engineering tools, including LLMs and AI coding agents, to accelerate code exploration, development, and testing while applying independent judgment and rigorous validation to the resulting designs and code. We welcome experienced developers with strong C, Linux, system programming skills and practical knowledge of database internals, storage, distributed systems, or other demanding enterprise software. Prior Oracle Database, RMAN, PL/SQL, or backup and recovery product experience is an advantage. Strong systems fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to translate complex requirements into reliable production software are essential. This position is based in Bengaluru, India. Responsibilities Product development and technical ownership Design, implement, and maintain ZDLRA features and enhancements in C and PL/SQL on Linux, contributing to Oracle database kernel and systems software development. Translate requirements and technical problems into clear designs, manageable tasks, and deliverable milestones. Evaluate alternatives and document trade-offs involving correctness, performance, scalability, compatibility, and maintainability. Apply appropriate algorithms and data structures to build efficient, reliable software. Reason about memory use, concurrency, synchronization, and behavior under demanding workloads. Develop and improve assigned components involving buffers, caches, storage, file systems, I/O, networking, and distributed processing, with careful attention to data integrity and recovery behavior. Build product expertise through code exploration, technical documentation, collaboration, and delivery of fixes and enhancements. Progress toward ownership of assigned features and projects, including subsequent development, maintenance, and defect resolution. Investigation, performance, and quality Investigate complex defects, including issues reported from customer deployments. Reproduce failures, trace relevant code paths, establish root causes, and implement durable fixes. Use GDB, core dumps, logs, traces, profiling tools, and Linux utilities to gather evidence and understand software behavior across interacting components. Diagnose performance and scalability bottlenecks involving CPU, memory, storage, I/O, and networking. Establish useful measurements and validate the impact of changes against representative workloads. Design and implement tests alongside production code. Cover functional behavior, boundary conditions, regressions, concurrency, and relevant failure and recovery scenarios using the team's engineering and test frameworks. Use shell scripting and automation to improve diagnostic data collection, issue reproduction, testing, and other repeatable development tasks. Follow secure coding practices and engineering standards. Evaluate error handling, resource management, backward compatibility, and versioning implications when modifying existing code or interfaces. Engineering execution and collaboration Take assigned work through the software development lifecycle, from analysis and design through implementation, review, testing, integration, and maintenance. Plan work realistically, identify dependencies, and communicate progress, design decisions, risks, and blockers. Coordinate with the engineering team to deliver agreed project milestones. Collaborate closely with ZDLRA engineers in India and the US and with relevant database engineering teams to resolve cross-component issues and deliver shared product objectives. Participate in design and code reviews, providing constructive feedback on correctness, clarity, performance, security, test coverage, and long-term maintainability. Write and maintain useful design notes, implementation documentation, and troubleshooting guidance. Share findings so that investigations and engineering decisions benefit the wider team. Use internal documentation, specifications, and existing code resourcefully to understand unfamiliar areas. Ask focused questions, seek timely feedback, and help colleagues solve technical problems. As product expertise grows, provide technical guidance, mentor colleagues, and contribute to improvements in the team's development practices and engineering quality. AI-assisted engineering Use LLMs and AI coding agents to accelerate code exploration, problem analysis, implementation, test development, and documentation where they are useful. Critically review AI-generated suggestions and verify them against the actual codebase, requirements, and observed behavior. Validate changes through appropriate reviews and tests, and remain accountable for the correctness, security, performance, and maintainability of delivered software. About Us Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. review_candidates.title: Senior Backend Engineer – Platform & Reliability
review_candidates.description: About Maesn Want to join a growing European startup early and be part of an epic journey? At Maesn we build software for other software companies. We provide an integration platform that lets B2B software companies add integrations to their platforms in hours and days instead of weeks and months. Our customers love us because we are innovative, quick, friendly and provide integrations for systems that others dare not touch. We are a young dynamic SaaS Startup born in Düsseldorf who believe in working hard and having fun while doing it. You will have the chance to work on all parts of our technology stack and in close collaboration with our customers, to understand their needs and get direct feedback on the changes you ship. The role Our platform sits between our customers and dozens of third-party accounting and ERP systems. That makes reliability part of our product. When a call is slow or fails, our customers need to know why, and so do we. You’ll be the senior engineer who owns how our platform runs in production, and you’ll keep building the product alongside the team. You’ll work directly with our CTO, Lennart Svensson, and the wider founder team. What you will do Own our Azure infrastructure end-to-end You know every service, how it’s deployed and what it costs. You’ll tighten what’s there and codify what isn’t. As we scale, you’ll keep the architecture simple: we run on managed services and plan to keep it that way. Bring real observability to the platform Metrics, logs, traces and alerts, across our services and the third-party APIs we call. You’ll define what “healthy” means, build the dashboards, and set up alerting and on-call so we catch problems before our clients do. When a mysterious timeout appears, you’re the one who can trace it to its source. Raise the bar on security and reliability Fintechs trust us with sensitive financial data. You’ll harden the platform, make sure we can deliver on incident response and SLAs, and keep us audit-ready as customers ask for certifications like SOC 2 or ISO 27001. Build product and level up the team You’ll ship features and integrations with the rest of the engineering team. You’ll also be the go-to person for production debugging, and you’ll mentor our engineers so the whole team gets better at running what we build. What you bring Experience: 5+ years building and running backend services in production, including real ownership of infrastructure, deployments and incidents. Production debugging: You’ve chased down latency spikes, timeouts and flaky dependencies, and you know how to go from “something is slow” to the root cause. Azure: Solid hands-on experience running production workloads on Azure. Observability: Experience instrumenting services with tracing, structured logging and metrics, ideally with OpenTelemetry or similar. Infrastructure-as-code mindset: You codify infrastructure rather than clicking through consoles. Security by default: You think about secrets, access management, and compliance as part of the work, not as an afterthought. Backend skills: You’re comfortable writing production code in TypeScript/Node.js and enjoy shipping features, not only keeping the lights on. Pragmatism and mentoring: You pick the simplest setup that works. You enjoy helping less experienced engineers grow, and you’re excited to set the standards for how we run our platform. What we offer First-hand experience building a fast-growing tech startup Kind teammates and great collaborative atmosphere Steep learning curve and a varied job with interesting projects and technologies Work fully remote or in our office in Düsseldorf Fun offsites where the team gets together to work and play One-time allowance for improving your home office Subsidized Urban Sports Club membership Laptop and work equipment 30 days of PTO + Local holidays

review_candidates.description: Company Description  HexWorld Solutions GmbH is a Dresden-based technology company focused on improving safety and efficiency on industrial construction sites such as data centers, semiconductor fabs, and large plant projects. Its HexBau platform centralizes permits to work, RAMS, and subcontractor daily reports, supporting structured two-stage approvals by construction management and EHS teams. The company collaborates closely with site managers, project managers, and EHS leads to streamline compliance and documentation processes. HexWorld Solutions operates with a modern, digital-first approach and offers opportunities to work on products that directly impact critical industrial projects. Role Description  The person in this role will help design, implement, and maintain end-to-end features for the HexBau platform, focusing on usability, reliability, performance, and security. Day-to-day tasks include building responsive user interfaces, writing clean, testable code across the stack, integrating with databases and APIs, assisting with troubleshooting and bug fixes, and ensuring seamless communication between the client and server. The Junior Full-Stack Developer will work closely with senior engineers to refine requirements, participate in code reviews, and contribute to technical documentation. The role offers exposure to industrial software workflows and the opportunity to grow within a supportive engineering environment. Qualifications  - Solid foundation in Programming and Software Development, with experience in modern front-end and back-end programming languages (e.g., JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java, C#, or Go).  - Strong understanding of both Front-End and Back-End Web Development concepts, including modern UI frameworks (like React, Angular, or Vue), APIs, databases, and server-side frameworks.  - Knowledge of software design patterns (such as Object-Oriented or Functional Programming principles) and the ability to apply them in practice.  - Ability to write clean, maintainable code across the entire stack and follow version control practices (e.g., Git).  - Strong problem-solving skills, ability to debug complex cross-stack issues, and willingness to learn from feedback and mentoring.  - Comfort working remotely, with good communication and time-management skills.  - Relevant education in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.  - Experience or interest in industrial, construction, or EHS-related software is a plus.
